title: 2020 COVID Crash & Rebound
storyline: A new virus shuts down the world economy. Equities fall by a third in five weeks, oil briefly goes negative, and then the largest monetary and fiscal response in history drives one of the fastest rebounds ever.

regime.name: Late-cycle calm
regime.description: Stocks are at record highs after a strong year, volatility is low and central banks are on hold.

events.headline: Wuhan locked down as new coronavirus spreads
events.altHeadline: Chinese city of 11 million locked down as a new virus spreads
events.body: Transport links are suspended days before the Lunar New Year holiday.

events.headline: Italy locks down northern towns as virus cases surge outside China
events.altHeadline: Europe reports its first big outbreak as virus cases surge outside China
events.body: South Korea and Iran also reported sharp increases in infections.

events.headline: Fed makes emergency 50bp rate cut
events.altHeadline: Fed makes an emergency 50bp rate cut between meetings
events.body: It is the first inter-meeting cut since 2008. The chair said the virus poses "evolving risks".

events.headline: Oil crashes 25% as Saudi Arabia launches price war; US stocks trip circuit breaker
events.altHeadline: Oil crashes 25% as producers launch a price war; US stocks trip a circuit breaker
events.body: Talks between major producers on output cuts collapsed over the weekend.

events.headline: WHO declares a pandemic; US bans travel from Europe
events.altHeadline: Health authorities declare a pandemic; US bans travel from Europe
events.body: Sports leagues, schools and offices are closing across the Western world.

events.headline: Fed cuts rates to zero and launches $700bn of QE in Sunday move
events.altHeadline: Fed cuts rates to zero and launches $700bn of bond purchases in a weekend move
events.body: Equity futures hit their limit-down level within minutes of the announcement.

events.headline: Fed pledges unlimited QE and will buy corporate bonds
events.altHeadline: Fed pledges unlimited bond purchases and will buy corporate debt
events.body: New facilities will support credit to large employers, households and cities.

events.headline: US passes $2.2tn CARES Act, the largest relief bill in history
events.altHeadline: US passes a $2.2 trillion relief act, the largest in its history
events.body: It includes direct cheques to households and forgivable loans to small firms.

events.headline: US crude futures settle below zero for the first time ever
events.altHeadline: US crude futures settle below zero for the first time ever
events.body: Storage is nearly full and holders of the expiring contract paid to offload barrels.

events.headline: Beijing to impose national security law on Hong Kong; Hang Seng sinks
events.altHeadline: Beijing moves to impose new security legislation on Hong Kong; local stocks sink
events.body: Washington warned the city's special trade status could be reviewed.

events.headline: Fed adopts average inflation targeting
events.altHeadline: Fed changes its framework to let inflation run above target for a time
events.body: The shift implies rates will stay near zero for longer.

events.headline: Ant Group's record IPO suspended two days before listing
events.altHeadline: Regulators suspend a record fintech IPO two days before listing
events.body: It follows new draft rules on online lending.

events.headline: Pfizer says its COVID vaccine is more than 90% effective
events.altHeadline: Drugmaker says its vaccine is more than 90% effective in a large trial
events.body: Travel, energy and bank shares surged while stay-at-home winners fell.
